notes: 展陈 layer.split：童话微缩花园竖图；6 层含 bg。语义：空舞台远景→左下蘑菇簇→池塘香蕉船→中央花瓣小屋→右侧树屋鼹鼠→前景蘑菇桌与步道草地。

modules.name: 1 背景空舞台
modules.keep: giant soft-focus garden leaves, pink-purple flower buds, blue sky gaps, golden sun god-rays from upper left — empty whimsical garden backdrop only
modules.remove: cottage, treehouse, mushroom table, pond, boat, mole, path, grass props, all characters and furniture

modules.name: 2 左侧蘑菇簇
modules.keep: cluster of stylized pink and blue spotted toadstools with white stems on grass
modules.remove: house, tree, pond, foreground table, background leaves beyond cluster

modules.name: 3 池塘香蕉船
modules.keep: round cobblestone pond, wooden pier, yellow banana-shaped boat with mast on water, small purple bell-flower lantern vine at left edge
modules.remove: main house, treehouse, mole, mushroom table, large background leaves

modules.name: 4 中央花瓣小屋
modules.keep: two-story fairy cottage with brown shingle lower roof, wooden door, circular window, large purple petal upper roof, green leaf finial, stone path segment at base
modules.remove: treehouse, pond, mushroom table, mole, distant giant leaves as separate props

modules.name: 5 树屋与鼹鼠
modules.keep: gnarled tree trunk, secondary treehouse with thatch roof and round window, yellow ladder, cheerful mole head from dirt mound, small gift boxes beside mound
modules.remove: main cottage, pond, foreground mushroom table, background-only bokeh

modules.name: 6 前景蘑菇桌与草地
modules.keep: large red spotted mushroom table with cheese wedge raspberry blueberries, lush grass with daisies, curved stone path, foreground lawn flowers
modules.remove: house walls, tree trunk core, pond water, background sky leaves
